scenario: Pluriactividad, the #9 worked example: salary 40,000 (employee SS 2,600) plus an established activity invoicing 30,000 to foreign clients, VC. The only expense is twelve months of the RETA cuota at the base mínima of tramo General 6 (4,802.40). The activity is past its first two profitable years, so the LIRPF art. 32.3 reduction for a new activity (#30) does not apply, and last year's net of 25,000 is above every minoración band. Modelo 130 collects 20 % of the activity net; stacked on the salary the activity income is taxed well above that, and the annual return collects the difference in June of the following year.

modelo130.oracleRef: Arithmetic under SPEC-003 §1, RD 439/2007 (RIRPF) art. 30.2ª and 110.1.a (boe.es consolidated text of BOE-A-2007-6820, read 2026-09-26) and AEAT, instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 02–19: casilla 02 includes difícil justificación of 5 % of the net to date, which stays below the 2,000 cap (5 % × 25,197.60 = 1,259.88). So 0.20 of a cumulative net growing by 6,299.40 − 314.97 = 5,984.43 a quarter. Casilla 04 is rounded to the cent each quarter (1,196.89, 2,393.77, 3,590.66, 4,787.54), so the payments alternate 1,196.89 and 1,196.88. No minoración because the previous year's net of 25,000 is above the 12,000 band of RD 439/2007 art. 110.3.c.
